name: Розвиток фігур (4)
description:
In the initial position, your pieces are passive. By developing the pieces towards more active squares, they can start to work together to attack enemy targets. In this lesson, a specific developing move is always significantly better than all alternatives.

What do you have to do?

Find the most optimal developing move. Sometimes this is castling.

examples.text: White has seized a lot of space. It is now important to defend the center well.
All white pieces are developed. Now it's time to castle as well. Do we choose short or long castling? Both options are good, but the best here is 1.0-0-0! So that white can attack on the kingside.

texts: This develops a piece with tempo.
Develop pieces with tempo if possible.
